answer: A concrete Sybil defence in an agent economy is the non-transferable deposit bond at registration. Each identity locks a fixed stake in the network's currency and binds it to one endpoint answering a liveness probe, so a thousand fake agents need a thousand funded bonds; stake cannot be pooled. If two seats resolve to one operator and either misbehaves, the cluster is slashed together, so a second identity has negative marginal value. The attacker pays the full bond per seat and recovers nothing. Cost scales with size while payoff does not, and witnesses catch willow, violet, ridge clones.
